newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary 1997 energy prices expected late October.
newsitem.headline: Hungary 1997 energy prices expected late October.

text.p: An announcement on rate increases for utilities should be made by late October, a government official said on Monday.
"The announcement of the increase rate will probably be made around the end of October," Industry and Trade Minister Tamas Suchman told reporters. He declined to give any figures.
"The increase will be based on a complex formula...There are 40 to 50 components to be considered," Suchman said.

The government last month postponed a rise in energy prices set for October 1 to January 1, saying the new deadline would still give utilities the eight percent profit margin stipulated under their privatisation agreements.

"Between October 7 and 20 representatives of the utilities, the Energy Office and the government's appointee will hold further negotiations and a proposal will be put forward to the government to consider," Suchman said.
He denied reports the rise will happen in two steps, saying the government will make good its promise to investors.

"The government has so far kept all its promises and a three-month delay is not a significant factor considering the long-term nature of the investments," he said. But he added that utilitiesowners had "intervened because of the price increase delay."
